scope: Adopted M01–M12 native surface release; the complete programming language remains in progress.
limitations: Only the named finite surface release is complete; GOAL.md remains authoritative.
Visible lofts and PBR materials do not add physical matter or motion authority.
Recorded GLB animation does not establish live destination physics.
Contacts, general dynamics, forces, physical and closed mechanisms, purposeful locomotion, textures, UV mapping, deformation/skinning, terrain, fluids and other GOAL domains remain open.
Finite fixture samples and reviewed views do not prove arbitrary-program continuous numerical or visual accuracy.
Unencoded analytic volume tolerances and measured float32 determinant perturbation bounds are distinct; raw reports retain both.
